claims.text: On the 4Q24 earnings call (period 2024-12-31, published 2025-01-16), CEO Ted Pick said Wealth Management's "investments in our self-directed and Workplace channels drive our differentiated client acquisition funnel," and that with its expanded offering the firm reaches "over 19 million relationships" and has added "net new assets of over $250 billion in each of the past two years."

On the 1Q25 earnings call (period 2025-03-31), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said fee-based flows were "again supported by assets migrating from advisor-led brokerage accounts to fee-based accounts" and by "assets migrating to the advisor-led channel that originated from the workplace channel," including "an incremental $20 billion this quarter, adding to the roughly $300 billion accumulated from workplace since we expanded our channel in 2020."

On the 2Q25 earnings call (period 2025-06-30), CEO Ted Pick described "ongoing investments in our world-class platform, including investments to support our advisors, a build-out of E*TRADE capabilities, and the expansion of our essential workplace channel" as "an engine for future growth."

On the 2Q25 earnings call (period 2025-06-30), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said "70% of the flows that come from workplace, that originate from workplace, is actually net new assets to the firm," describing it as "an incredible number" and evidence of "what we intended to see in the investments in workplace."

On the 3Q25 earnings call (period 2025-09-30), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said assets "that originated from workplace continue to migrate into our advisor-led channel as a result of the consistent investments we have made into our differentiated platform," and the firm continues "to invest, deepening our competitive moats in areas like our expanded collaboration with Carta in private markets and in digital assets through announced partnerships with Zero Hash."

On the 3Q25 earnings call (period 2025-09-30), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said the firm has been "increasing our marketing and business development" in self-directed, is "attracting assets held away" and "bringing in new clients... a lot of the tools that we've been giving to our advisors," while workplace "is bringing in assets not just in NNA, but also directly into fee-based flows."

On the 4Q25 earnings call (period 2025-12-31), CEO Ted Pick said "We continue to invest in each of our three business segments: Wealth, Institutional Securities, and Investment Management via human capital and technology," and that "The funnel is working," citing "$1.6 trillion plus of net new assets" over the last five years "with a doubling of fee-based flows."

On the 4Q25 earnings call (period 2025-12-31), management said "Advisor-led assets originating from workplace and E*TRADE relationships accelerated, growing to a record $99 billion for the full year, compared to historical averages of around $60 billion per year," and that "Workplace and E-Trade relationships continue to seek out advice."

On the 1Q26 earnings call (period 2026-03-31), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said household penetration of lending products "is now at 18%... up from 14% just 5 years ago through ongoing investments in technology, adviser and client education, and an expanded product set."

On the 2Q26 earnings call (period 2026-06-30), CFO Sharon Yeshaya described "the workplace channel as a strong contributor to the top of the funnel," saying "Workplace brings relationships and assets onto the platform" and "Our investments are extending our runway for growth," including continuing to "deliver advice and solutions to new and existing relationships, supporting the build in our fee-based assets."

On the 2Q26 earnings call (period 2026-06-30), CEO Ted Pick said "Growth led by workplace relationships reflects a cornerstone of our client acquisition funnel" and "Our ability to serve clients across the private to public continuum continues to attract assets to our world-class platform."

On the 2Q26 earnings call (period 2026-06-30), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said "The execution of our strategy, particularly our sustained investments in our client acquisition funnel allowed us to reach more clients and deepen existing relationships."

On the 3Q26 earnings call (period 2026-09-30), CEO Ted Pick said the E*TRADE acquisition "completed the funnel," describing it as "this extraordinary self-directed piece, the workplace and then, of course, the financial adviser."
On the 3Q26 earnings call (period 2026-09-30), CFO Sharon Yeshaya said "our pipeline and our connectivity across channels allows us to build relationships early and deepen them over time."
